_comment: Single source of truth for the portfolio's PUBLIC disclosures. Each record renders the site #disclosures row AND a sota-bench README line via tools/generate_disclosures.py. ADD a credit = append one record + run the generator (with --verify). A record renders ONLY if proof.published is true AND it carries a url (fail-closed). NEVER add a finding whose advisory is not live-published: the generator's --verify mode re-checks each proof against the live GitHub state, so an embargoed/triage/un-realized finding cannot ship. Order here is the on-site order: highest published CVSS first (the flagship), self-assessed rows kept inside their severity tier. A record whose advisory carries NO published CVSS sets cvss_published:false; the generator then renders the severity tier WITHOUT a numeric chip, so a self-assessed score is never shown as a published metric (the score field is retained for ordering/record-keeping only).
_embargo_rule: proof.published must be backed by a LIVE state check at publish time (repo security-advisory state==published, OR presence in the GitHub global advisory DB), NEVER a stored string. Findings still in private coordination are intentionally NOT listed here until their advisory or credit actually publishes.

findings.name: Open WebUI
findings.desc: Server-side request forgery via an OAuth picture claim (CWE-918): validate_url checks only the initial URL, then aiohttp follows a redirect to an internal target and returns its body through the profile image. Sole-lead; the sixth redirect sink the v0.9.5 parent fix (CVE-2026-45401) missed. CVE-2026-54008.

proof.note: Repo advisory published 2026-06-11T18:56:45Z with CVE-2026-54008 (CVSS 8.5, CWE-918 SSRF; CVSS v3 score confirmed on the advisory). matte1782 is the SOLE reporter (state accepted); Classic298 is remediation_developer, NOT a co-reporter (verified via credits_detailed). Incomplete-fix sibling of CVE-2026-45401, whose v0.9.5 fix (five other reporters) patched five redirect sinks; this is the sixth, _process_picture_url. Not yet synced to the GitHub global advisory DB; citation is the public repo advisory URL (anonymous HTTP 200 confirmed 2026-06-11).

findings.name: dex
findings.desc: Token-exchange endpoint missing per-client connector ACL enforcement (CWE-285). Reporter fix-PR merged. Severity self-assessed; the advisory carries no CVSS and no CVE (master-only).

proof.note: Accepted + reporter-credited; no CVE (master-only, no released tag carried the bug). The advisory carries NO published CVSS (cvss_v3 and cvss_v4 both null, verified live 2026-06-12); the 8.7 is the author's self-assessment and is NOT rendered as a published metric (cvss_published:false). Citation is the repo advisory URL; not in the GitHub global DB by design.

findings.name: Langroid
findings.desc: Neo4jChatAgent runs LLM-generated Cypher with no validation: prompt-to-Cypher injection on the agent surface, config-conditional RCE. The query-validation fix shipped for SQLChatAgent (CVE-2026-25879) was never carried to the Neo4j path, so read_query / write_query executed the model's Cypher directly. Found by sibling-diff from that prior fix; reporter-credited, and the 0.65.5 patch extended validation to Cypher and AQL. Severity self-assessed; the advisory carries no CVSS and no CVE.

proof.note: Repo advisory live and published (state=published, verified via gh on 2026-06-15; anonymous HTTP 200 on the advisory URL also confirmed). Severity High per the advisory's qualitative rating; the advisory carries NO CVSS and lists NO CWEs and NO CVE (cve=null), so cvss_published:false (no numeric chip is rendered; the 8.1 is the author's self-assessment, retained for ordering only) and it is cited as a GHSA, not a CVE. NOT in the GitHub global advisory DB (advisories/GHSA-2pq5-3q89-j7cc returns 404), so proof type is repo_advisory and the citation is the repo advisory URL. matte1782 is the credited reporter. Incomplete-fix sibling of CVE-2026-25879 (the SQLChatAgent query-validation fix) found by sibling-diff; maintainer Prasad Chalasani (@pchalasani) shipped 0.65.5 and, on the reporter's follow-up, extended validation to cover Cypher and AQL (ArangoDB), not just the reported Neo4j path.

findings.name: ouroboros
findings.desc: Untrusted project .env (auto-loaded from the working directory) can still reach RCE via execution-routing keys omitted from the denylist — an incomplete fix of CVE-2026-47211, found by sibling-diff. Co-credited reporter (with hackkim). Fixed in ouroboros-ai 0.42.1 (keys added to _UNTRUSTED_ENV_DENYLIST + cwd auto-discovery removed). Severity self-assessed; the advisory carries no CVSS and no CVE.

proof.note: Repo advisory published 2026-06-18T14:21:06Z (state=published, verified via gh + anonymous HTTP 200 on the advisory URL). HIGH, no CVSS numeric and no CVE (cve=null) -> cvss_published:false (the 7.5 is a self-assessment for ordering only), cited as a GHSA. NOT in the global advisory DB (404), so proof type is repo_advisory. CO-REPORTED: credits_detailed lists matte1782 AND hackkim, both state=accepted, type=reporter -> framed as co-credit, not sole. Incomplete fix of CVE-2026-47211 (untrusted project .env -> RCE): execution-routing keys omitted from _UNTRUSTED_ENV_DENYLIST; fixed in ouroboros-ai 0.42.1.

findings.desc: Lockdown-mode RepoAccessCache singleton in HTTP mode binds every user's repo-access checks to the first authenticated user's GraphQL token: cross-user authorization confusion (CWE-284). CVE-2026-48529. Credited reporter (co-reported). Patched 1.1.2.

proof.note: Repo advisory published 2026-06-09 with CVE-2026-48529 (CVSS v3 6.0, CWE-284 Improper Access Control). Not yet synced to the GitHub global advisory DB (lag, like Outline). matte1782 is a credited reporter, co-reported with hewei-gikaku (not sole discoverer). Citation is the public repo advisory URL (anonymous HTTP 200).

findings.desc: Content locks disclose IDs and emails of otherwise-inaccessible users (CWE-862). CVE-2026-45334.

proof.note: Published in the GitHub global advisory DB with CVE-2026-45334. Score shown is the published CVSS v4 (5.3).

findings.name: Outline
findings.desc: Cross-tenant IDOR in subscription creation on private documents (CWE-639). CVE-2026-43890. Shown at the GHSA's qualitative Medium; the advisory carries no CVSS (NVD separately lists 7.7 via a GitHub-supplied vector).

proof.note: Repo advisory is published with CVE-2026-43890 assigned, but the CVE is ABSENT from the GitHub global advisory DB (known discrepancy). The GHSA carries NO CVSS (cvss_v3 and cvss_v4 both null, verified live 2026-06-12); NVD separately lists a CVSS v3 of 7.7 (HIGH) from a GitHub-supplied secondary vector. Shown at the GHSA's qualitative Medium with cvss_published:false; the 4.4 is the author's self-assessment, not rendered. Citation is the repo advisory URL.

findings.name: Google MCP Toolbox
findings.desc: Credited reporter on a MERGED FIX (not an advisory; no GHSA/CVE): allowedDatasets scope-bypass in the BigQuery forecast / analyze-contribution tools of Google's MCP Toolbox. The Google maintainer merged the fix and credited the report in the PR body. Severity self-assessed.

proof.note: Public PR googleapis/mcp-toolbox#3324, merged 2026-06-04 into main by @duwenxin99; the merged PR body credits 'Reported by: Matteo Panzeri @matte1782'. No GHSA/CVE (the repo has no published security-advisories). Scoped to the public allowedDatasets-bypass fix ONLY; the broader email-coordinated report is deliberately NOT represented here. The --verify gate live-checks repos/googleapis/mcp-toolbox/pulls/3324 .merged == true AND that 'matte1782' is present in the PR body, fail-closed.
